meta.title: Acme Bank | Mobile Banking App
meta.description: The official Acme Bank mobile banking app — secure, convenient, fully digital banking.

hero.subhead: Secure, convenient, and fully digital banking — anytime, anywhere.

paragraphs: Acme Bank is committed to delivering accessible, trustworthy financial services to the communities we serve.
We build lasting relationships with our clients while maintaining full compliance with regulatory standards and good governance.

offerings.label: What You Can Do
offerings.heading: Bank Offerings
offerings.intro: Explore the products and services we offer to help you grow and manage your finances.

items.title: Deposit Accounts
items.body: Insured savings and checking accounts for everyday banking.

items.title: Fund Transfers
items.body: Send money instantly to other accounts and external banks.

items.title: Bills Payment
items.body: Pay utilities and other billers directly from the app.

items.title: Loans
items.body: Flexible financing for homes, vehicles, business, and personal needs.

items.title: Account Overview
items.body: View balances, transaction history, and e-statements anytime.

items.title: 24/7 Support
items.body: Access in-app support, FAQs, and contact channels day or night.

support.label: App Support & Contact
support.heading: We're Here to Help
support.intro: For any questions, concerns, or technical issues with the app, reach out through any channel below.
support.phoneNote: Phone support: Mon – Fri, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

privacy.label: Legal & Data Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Acme Bank is committed to protecting the privacy and security of the information you share with us.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Who operates the app, the bank's license/regulator, and how to reach you about this policy.

sections.heading: 2. What data we collect
sections.body: The categories of account, transaction, device, and usage data the app collects.

sections.heading: 3. How we use your data
sections.body: The purposes: opening accounts, processing transactions, compliance checks, fraud prevention, notifications.

sections.heading: 4. Data sharing
sections.body: Who you share data with (processors, clearing partners, regulators) and on what basis.

sections.heading: 5. Data retention
sections.body: How long data is kept and the legal basis for the retention period.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: The data-subject rights available and how to exercise them.

sections.heading: 7. Security
sections.body: Encryption, access controls, and auditing measures that protect the data.

sections.heading: 8. Contact us
sections.body: Full contact details, including the Data Privacy Officer.

deletion.label: Account & Data
deletion.heading: Request Account or Data Deletion
deletion.intro: You may request the deletion of your account and the personal data associated with it. Please read the information below before submitting.
deletion.whatItMeans: Deleting your account permanently removes your app access. Transaction records may be retained for a period required by law.

steps.title: Settle pending transactions
steps.body: Ensure no pending transfers, payments, or loan obligations remain.

steps.title: Submit your request
steps.body: Request the deletion of your account and personal data using either of the following methods:

methods.title: Email us
methods.body: Send an email to support@acmebank.example with the subject "Delete My Account", from the address registered to your account so we can verify your identity.

methods.title: Visit a branch
methods.body: Visit any branch and request account or data deletion in person. Please bring a valid government-issued ID.

steps.title: Deletion completed
steps.body: Your app account and non-regulated data are deleted within 15 business days.
